```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Note Show</title>
    @livewireStyles
    <link href="{{ mix('css/app.css') }}" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-100 font-sans antialiased">
    <div class="max-w-screen-xl mx-auto p-4">
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">Note Show</h1>

        <div wire:key="{{ $note->id }}" class="shadow-lg rounded bg-white p-6 mt-4 space-y-3">
            <div class="mb-4">
                <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold">{{ $note->title }}</h2>
                <p class="text-gray-700">Created at: {{ $note->created_at }}</p>
            </div>

            <textarea wire:model="note.content" placeholder="Edit Note..." class="w-full h-40 rounded border border-gray-300 p-2 bg-white focus:border-blue-500"></textarea>

            <div class="flex justify-between mt-4">
                <button type="button" onclick="{{ $note->edit() }}" class="px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium bg-green-500 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-green-600">Edit</button>
                <button type="button" onclick="{{ $note->delete() }}" class="px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium bg-red-500 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-600">Delete</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        @livewireScripts
    </div>
</body>
</html>
```

This Blade template includes a simple form to edit and delete notes. The `wire:model` directive is used for two-way data binding, allowing the note content to be dynamically updated in real-time. The `wire:key` directive is used to ensure that Livewire can track changes efficiently. The button interactions trigger the corresponding methods on the `NoteShowComponent` using Livewire's event dispatching system.
